notes: v1.14.594 - A.2 SHIP 3: THE NOTES ADAPTER. Handoff docs/SHIP-HANDOFF-A2-ASSEMBLER.md section 5; rulings OWNER-RULINGS.md 2026-09-17 (Q-18 to Q-27 as recommended, Ship 3 gated on Chromium); Phase 0 docs/A2-SHIP3-PHASE0-EVIDENCE.md; evidence docs/A2-SHIP3-EVIDENCE.md.  WHAT A TECHNICIAN SEES: nothing, unless the page is opened with ?rrdev=1. No nav entry, no dock change, no other surface touched. In the ?rrdev=1 readout the coverage line gains a notes row and the Record timeline gains note.logged events.  WHAT IT IS. A fourth adapter, notes, reads phantom_deploy_audit_v1 through the assembler own raw reader _rr_readKey, never through deploy_loadAllAudit, deploy_loadAuditFor or deploy_verifyAuditChain, each of which quarantines a damaged key, writes the crash log, or needs sha256 over the whole device log. A note is an audit entry whose action is RACK_NOTE, whose entityType is rack, and whose entityId equals the rack composite - all three, whole-string (Q-18). The entry rack field is never a match key: its one live writer is BLOCKER_OPENED, the blockers adapter moment, so matching it would double-count and reprint the blocker text. Deployment field notes (OMNI_NOTE), voice notes, issue notes, discrepancy notes and checklist item notes all stay out (Q-19, Q-20, Q-27). Each note emits note.logged at its ts carrying auditId, text and actor verbatim, including a System or Build-Lead actor fallback (Q-25). An entry with no finite ts is counted and never timed, and the notes coverage row says so. A chainReset marker anywhere in the log - the 2000-entry cap or a restore - is reported in that row detail, which now rides an empty row too (Q-23), and the wording never states a number of lost entries because truncatedCount does not accumulate (lead L-7). status gains no key: the note count is the notes row events (Q-22). No storage writer, renderer, stripeRack_logNote, deploy_logAudit, deploy_purgeAudit, HISTORY, NERVE, shift report, handoff generator or deploy_generateReport is changed.  PROOF, on laptop-chromium by owner ruling because Windows Smart App Control blocks Playwright WebKit on this machine (probed 2026-09-17, still blocked on 2026-09-21: WebKit Host system is missing dependencies, Chromium 151 launches). test/e2e/65-rack-record-assembler.spec.js: RED on .593, 14 failed for the missing feature and nothing else and the 13 untouched Ship 1-2 tests passed; GREEN 27/27; all 12 planned mutations caught and each restored byte-exact against the post-GREEN sha256. Regression, each spec alone: 64-report-engine-characterization 8/8 (report output unchanged, handoff acceptance 3), 00-boot 4/4, 63-handoff-readiness-gate 5/5, 12-blockers 8/8, 13-phase-model 13/13, 27-rack-capabilities-in-build 8/8, 04-storage 18 passed 2 failed 1 skipped, 98-cmd-census 26 passed 1 failed, 01-nav 12 passed 6 skipped 1 failed. Every red was classified by running the same spec alone against untouched c24cf12 in a temporary git worktree on its own port: 04-storage fails the SAME two tests there, 98-cmd-census the same one, 01-nav the same one. Introduced by Ship 3: none. Note that 04-storage 461 and 605 now fail on this box where they passed on 2026-09-17 - they fail identically on untouched c24cf12, so the environment changed, not the code.  DEVICE VERIFY OWED, and it is this ship only WebKit check: a Safari tab on https://phantom-staging.wfj6t2fk7w.workers.dev/dct-ios.html, per docs/A2-SHIP3-EVIDENCE.md section 6. Use a one-rack deployment and compare the readout against the RACK_NOTE rows in HISTORY (Q-26). PASS: before any note the coverage line ends with notes empty; after two LOG NOTE entries it reads notes ok (2) with your text and operator in the JSON, and status.phase and openBlockers are unchanged. NERVE RECENT ACTIVITY showing fewer notes, the shift report Field Notes count ignoring rack notes, and the HISTORY header counting every action are recorded disagreements, not FAILs. FAIL: notes reads error, a count that does not match the RACK_NOTE rows, a note made from a blocker or field-note row, any event without a numeric t, or any trace of the readout without the param.
